lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you know what brand they are?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You don’t know that brand name.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Nike or Adidas, somethin’ like that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Starters, OK. (pause) When this is all going on, did Steve say anything about Teresa?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You told us two days ago that Steve was angry. Was that true?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So Steve was not angry? (Brendan shakes head “no”) So why do you think he did this to Teresa?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Maybe because he wanted to go back to jail.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he ever tell you that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No, that’s what I was thinking.
